newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly up in higher trade driven by the bonds market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 474.02 from 473.87 on Friday.
Volume was 1.2 million dinars, including 845,590 on the bonds market. It was 505,575 dinars on Friday.
UBCI bank was up one dinar to 45.5 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels rose 0.29 dinar to 10.11.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 1.1 dinar to 17.69 dinars. BTEI bank eased 0.2 dinar to 21.8 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
